hero.title: Train smarter.
hero.subtitle: Connect Strava, Garmin and TrainingPeaks. EnduranceAI analyzes every heartbeat, watt and night of sleep to predict your performance, flag injury risk and coach you in plain language.

features.title: Everything your data has been trying to tell you
features.subtitle: One platform. Every metric. Answers in plain language, not spreadsheets.

items.name: AI Coach
items.desc: Ask anything about your own training. "Can I go hard tomorrow?" gets an answer that cites your actual load and HRV — not generic advice.

items.name: Race Predictions
items.desc: Finish times with confidence intervals for 5k through Ironman, driven by a physiological model corrected by your current form.

items.name: Injury Risk
items.desc: See your risk percentage and exactly which factors drive it: load spikes, HRV suppression, sleep debt, missing rest days.

items.name: Scenario Simulator
items.desc: Lose 4 kg? Sleep 8 hours? Add 10% volume? Every prediction recalculates instantly so you can plan with evidence.

items.name: Weekly Reports
items.desc: Your week, understood: volume, load, recovery, strengths, weaknesses and what to do next — generated automatically.

items.name: Performance Score
items.desc: One 0–100 number blending sleep, HRV, load balance, consistency and fitness trend. Know where you stand at a glance.

steps.name: Connect
steps.desc: Link Strava, Garmin, TrainingPeaks, Zwift, Apple Health, COROS, Polar or Suunto. We sync automatically every 15 minutes.

steps.name: Analyze
steps.desc: Our models compute your training load, recovery state, injury risk and race predictions from every activity and every night of sleep.

steps.name: Improve
steps.desc: Get daily guidance, weekly reports and answers to any question — grounded in your data, explained in plain language.
